Summary: The remaining payment is to be made after final checking of the bill within 28 working days of submission of the bill by the contractor.

Summary: 2.5% of each running and final bill is deducted as security deposit, capped at 2.5% of the tendered amount.
Quote: deduct a sum at the rate of 2.5% of the gross amount of each running and final bill till the sum deducted will amount to security deposit of 2.5% of the tendered amount of the work.
Notes: The security deposit is collected from running and final bills at 2.5% up to a maximum of 2.5% of the tendered amount.

Summary: Mobilization advance not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount, bearing 8% simple interest per annum.

Notes: Bears simple interest at 8 percent per annum. Recovery is made by deductions from contractor bills starting after the first 10% of the gross value of work is executed, aiming for full recovery by the time 80% is executed.
